description: Searches every open job GetMattered can apply to, by words, place, seniority and job type, whatever the user's saved search covers. Changes nothing on the account and spends nothing. Each result has the job_match_id or job_url getmattered_apply takes.

companies.description: Companies to keep, up to 10 names.

experience_levels.description: Levels to keep: intern, entry, junior, mid, senior, lead, executive. A job that states no level stays in.

job_types.description: Job types to keep: full_time, part_time, contract, internship, freelance, temporary. A job that states no type stays in.

location.description: A city or country (e.g. "San Francisco", "Germany") or "Remote". Without it, the countries in the user's job preferences.

needs_visa_sponsorship.description: If true, jobs that rule out visa sponsorship are left out.

posted_within_days.description: How many days back to search by posting date, 1 to 30.

query.description: A job title or words from one (e.g. "Founding Engineer"). Without it, the job titles in the user's job preferences.

remote_only.description: If true, the list holds only remote jobs.

salary_min.description: Lowest yearly pay in US dollars (e.g. 120000). A job that states no pay stays in.

name: getmattered_search_jobs

jobs.description: Best first, each one a job GetMattered can send now. The search saved nothing.

hiringSystem.description: The employer's hiring system GetMattered sends this application on.

jobMatchId.description: The job_match_id getmattered_apply takes, when the user already has this job as a match.

jobUrl.description: The employer's own posting. getmattered_apply takes it as job_url when jobMatchId is null.

salaryMaxUsd.description: Highest yearly pay the posting states, in US dollars.

salaryMinUsd.description: Lowest yearly pay the posting states, in US dollars.

outcome.description: found: jobs GetMattered can send now; none_found: the search ran and found none; no_query: no job title was given or saved; no_place: the location names no country GetMattered searches, or none is saved; no_remote_country: remote jobs were asked with no country given or saved.

searchedCountries.description: The countries the search read, as ISO codes.

searchedTitles.description: The job titles the search read.

setupStep.description: Present while account setup is open: the first setup step.

title: Search Jobs
